literal_meaning: সীমা বা হদ্দে পৌঁছানো (limit or extent to become)
figurative_meaning_en: To become extremely tired or exhausted
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুরো রাত জেগে পড়াশোনা করায় হদ্দ হয়ে গেছি।
example_sentences_in_english: I stayed up all night studying and now I'm completely exhausted.
I've been standing in the shop all day and I'm dead tired.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali expressions of physical or mental fatigue, commonly used in informal settings.
